field_changes.old: Sharing your workouts just got a whole lot more fun — you can now scroll through beautiful new share cards including milestone achievements and personal 1RM records, pick your favorite, and post straight to your social apps. The end-workout screen also has a smoother animation, and day order now stays correct when copying or editing your routines. Plus a handful of reliability improvements and bug fixes.
field_changes.new: Editing your Adaptive Plan just got smoother! Elite members now see instant confirmation whenever you swap, add, or delete exercises — whether you're mid-workout or wrapping up on the Workout Complete screen. Changes come with a built-in cooldown to keep your plan feeling intentional. Post-workout summary cards also got a polish pass on volume display, plus a handful of reliability fixes.
